capabilities: Show a configurable dashboard with greeting, date card, and accent color
Create notes, projects, and tasks quickly from the dashboard
Count notes, projects, and tasks from Markdown frontmatter
Display note creation heatmap, note graph, recent notes, recent tasks, and tag cloud
Refresh the dashboard within about one second of vault changes
extras: Manual install from GitHub Release zip; works without dotpm but Create project/task buttons fail and labels fall back to raw IDs. Not desktop-only; UI in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in at-a-glance screen combining today's date, quick capture, and counts of notes, projects, and tasks.

relations.evidence: This plugin integrates with the following third-party plugin to provide full functionality.

summary: Custom dashboard view showing date, quick capture, note/project/task counts, heatmap, note graph, recents, and tag cloud.
